title: PEB Dairy Shed for Dravton Dairy, 39,330 Sq Ft | Steel Mind
description: Steel Mind built a 39,330 sq ft PEB dairy shed for Dravton Dairy at Chunian: 17 ft high, 115 ft wide and 342 ft long, with shade and airflow.
h1: PEB Dairy Shed for Dravton Dairy at Chunian: 39,330 Square Feet of Steel Cattle Housing
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. built a pre-engineered dairy shed for Dravton Dairy at Chunian. The shed is 17 feet high, 115 feet wide and 342 feet long and covers 39,330 square feet. It is the largest dairy shed Steel Mind has built.
alt: Large PEB dairy shed built by Steel Mind for Dravton Dairy at Chunian.

faq.q: How big is the Dravton Dairy shed?
faq.a: It covers 39,330 square feet, with a width of 115 feet and a length of 342 feet.

faq.q: Why use steel for dairy sheds?
faq.a: Steel goes up quickly, spans wide areas and allows extra bays when the herd grows.

blocks.text: This shed houses a large part of the Dravton Dairy herd under one roof. Steel Mind designed the building as a pre-engineered system, made the steel in Lahore and erected it at the farm in Chunian.

A long shed needs regular bays, a high roof and an open ridge so that hot air can leave. Open or louvered sides let air cross the shed. The frame spacing follows the feed alleys and stalls. Gutters and floor slopes are planned with the farm so rain and waste move away from the animals.
Steel Mind can build long, wide dairy housing of almost 40,000 square feet. It has built four structures for Dravton Dairy at Chunian, so the farm has a record of growth with one contractor.
